name: WeatherBench 2
description: WeatherBench 2 is an open-source benchmark for evaluating global medium-range weather forecasting models over 1-14 day lead times. It provides standardized data, baselines, and continuously updated leaderboards for comparing data-driven and physical forecasting systems using meteorological verification metrics.
evaluation_method: forecast skill metrics such as anomaly correlation coefficient, root mean square error, and other operational weather-verification scores over multiple lead times and atmospheric variables
notes: Continuously updated benchmark and leaderboard; exact typical SOTA score depends on variable, region, and lead time. Often used to compare ML weather models against physical baselines.
